finalPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: colorized derivative of a novel illustration for a character portrait library.
Input image 1 is the sole EDIT TARGET: the existing black-and-white novel illustration of Fu Xiaoli (福小莉). Add color to this exact illustration, keeping the original drawing, framing, proportions, and composition.

Color guidance supported by the novel: long BLACK hair and a naturally darker brown complexion; WHITE institutional clothing with straps. Use a gentle warm medium-to-deep brown skin tone with subtle soft highlights and restrained natural shading on the already exposed face, neck, hand, and legs. Render the long hair deep neutral black, with restrained cool charcoal highlights preserving each original strand and highlight contour. Neutral deep brown irises are an artistic choice because her ordinary iris color is unspecified. Keep the outfit bright white with soft cool gray shadows, straps and collar dark charcoal gray, and the existing chest chain neutral steel gray. These strap and iris colors are neutral artistic choices, not an official palette.

Preserve every identity and drawing invariant: her original face shape, large eyes, eyebrows, small gentle smile, nose, bang shapes, all long flowing hair contours, head and shoulder tilt, raised hand pose, exact original clothing coverage, wide sleeves, seams, each existing strap, the original dark neck collar, and each link of the existing chain. Do not redesign the face, hair, body, outfit, or pose; this is line-art colorization only. Keep the original white backdrop and scattered fragments as shown. Retain the original © Won signature at its original upper right position. Preserve the existing crop and portrait aspect ratio.

Avoid exaggerated yellow or red skin, heavy cosmetics, stereotypes, ethnicity inference, glossy photorealism, newly invented jewelry, extra characters, new restraints or foot chains or iron balls outside the original frame, added objects, extensions of the drawing, shield frames, decorative borders, webpage UI, headings, or additional lettering. The background must remain opaque.
